field.label: Enabled
field.help: Disable to keep this server in the list for monitoring without using it for time.

field.label: Host
field.help: Hostname or IP address of the time server.

field.label: Prefer
field.help: Indicates that NTP should favor the use of this server more than all others.

field.label: Pool
field.help: Marks this entry as a pool hostname, allowing NTP to resolve and use multiple servers from it.

field.label: Iburst
field.help: Enables faster clock synchronization on startup at the expense of the peer.
